criteria.frame_test: refuse a painting with any pixel on its outermost row or column (the 1 px border, 8188 pixels at 1664x2432) whose minimum channel is <= 200; bbox_min_channel_le_200 is the inclusive [x0, y0, x1, y1] box of every pixel of the painting whose minimum channel is <= 200, so on a grey background it is the whole image
criteria.paint_elapsed_s: the GPU job time of the painting, as the painting run logged it
criteria.seethrough_full_elapsed_s: the full See-through run's elapsed seconds, from its meta.json
criteria.layers_warn_lines: WARN lines printed by `spine-parts layers` over the full run
criteria.layers_full: layers in the full run's manifest
criteria.opaque_px: pixels with alpha > 8 in the full run's layer PNG (the `opaque_px` column of `spine-parts layers`)

selection_rule: refuse a painting by the frame test; then fewest layers_warn_lines; then most layers_full; then lowest seed
